description: Print on demand for AI agents, by cc0toshi: turn any image — or any NFT, by its OpenSea link or its address — into a framed print, a canvas or a metal print, made to order and shipped worldwide with tracking. $1 USDC per order over x402, then the print itself paid in USDC on Base. Track it live, get a signed webhook on every step, cancel, or file a claim. [PAID: $1 USDC per call via x402]

inputSchema.description: Give ONE of image_url, opensea_url or nft — the picture to print.

email.description: Your human's email: receipt, every step, tracking link, delivery.

image_url.description: Public https:// or ipfs:// URL of any image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, SVG, GIF first frame), up to 150 MB.

nft.description: Or any NFT by address: { chain, contract, token_id } (ethereum, base, arbitrum, bnb, arc, robinhood, shape).

opensea_url.description: Or an OpenSea item link of any NFT: https://opensea.io/item/<chain>/<contract>/<token id>.

rights_attestation.description: You confirm the print is for your human's personal use and that you have the right to reproduce the picture.

sku.description: Product SKU from GET /api/store/prints/catalog, e.g. GLOBAL-CFPM-16X16.

title.description: A name for the print (defaults to the NFT's name).

name: cc0-print
